_comment: Single source of the server address baked into each Android build. Read by scripts/build-android.mjs and by the Gradle bundle guard in client/android/app/build.gradle. Public URLs only: never put credentials, database URLs or keys here.

production._note: Live production service (real business data) despite the hostname; confirmed 22 Nov 2026. Used by BOTH the debug (in.linecart.suite.debug) and release (in.linecart.suite) APKs.

local._note: Developer-only build (in.linecart.suite.local) against a local server on the emulator host. Never production data.
